title: BMI Calculator
description: Calculate BMI, determine weight categories, and support both metric and imperial units.

steps.title: Calculate BMI
steps.description: Write a `calcBMI` function that takes weight (kg) and height (m) and returns the BMI using `weight / (height * height)`.
hints: Weight is in kilograms, height in meters

steps.title: BMI category
steps.description: Write a `getCategory` function that returns the weight category: underweight (<18.5), normal (18.5-24.9), overweight (25-29.9), or obese (>=30).
hints: Use if/else if/else for the ranges

steps.title: Metric BMI calculator
steps.description: Write a `bmiMetric` function that combines calcBMI and getCategory to return a full result string.
hints: Call calcBMI to get the numeric value
Call getCategory to get the category

verification.successMessage: Metric BMI result with category displayed!
verification.failureMessage: The result should include 'BMI:' and the category.

steps.title: Imperial BMI conversion
steps.description: Write a `bmiImperial` function that accepts weight (lbs) and height (inches) and converts to metric internally. Use `weight * 703 / (height * height)`.
hints: Use the same getCategory function for the result

verification.failureMessage: Use the formula (weight * 703) / (height * height) and include the category.

steps.title: Person object with BMI
steps.description: Create a `Person` object (or class) with weight, height, and a `bmi` method that calculates and returns the result.
hints: Store name, weight, height as properties
Add a bmi() method that computes and returns the BMI
Add a describe() method that prints a full report

verification.successMessage: The Person object calculates BMI and returns a full report!
verification.failureMessage: describe() should include the person's name and their BMI result.
